name: Röntgen
about: Röntgen is a free, open-source icon set with 574 icons designed by Sergey Vartanov. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under CC BY 4.0.

faqs.a: Yes. All 574 Röntgen are open source under the CC BY 4.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the CC BY 4.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use Röntgen in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.
There are 574 icons in the Röntgen set, designed by Sergey Vartanov. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of Röntgen?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are Röntgen available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
